The Caste-Free Village "Soundala" Where Politicians Are Banned! | Tammareddy Bharadwaja | Modi 


Unique Village Model (Soundal, Ahilyanagar): Renowned filmmaker and social analyst Thammareddy Bharadwaja discusses the inspiring model of Soundal village, where traditional caste identities and surnames are completely discarded to foster unity.

Strict Community Rules & Discipline: The village enforces progressive guidelines, including a dedicated study hour enforced by a siren where mobile phones and TVs are strictly prohibited, ensuring children's education is prioritized.

Prohibition of Political Interference: Political leaders and parties are kept out during election cycles to prevent corruption, factionalism, and division, allowing the community to self-govern effectively.

Self-Reliant Infrastructure: Instead of waiting for government aid, the villagers collectively fund and build their own concrete roads, maintain cleanliness, and manage local welfare initiatives.

Thammareddy's Critique on Corruption: Thammareddy Bharadwaja sharply criticizes systemic government corruption, massive estimation inflation in public projects, and the heavy tax burdens on citizens, contrasting it with the self-sustaining efficiency of model villages.

AP తీరం వైపు ఆక్వాన్ ముప్పు.. IMD Officer Nagaratnam About Aquan Cyclone Effect: High Alert!| iDream


Cyclone System & Current Position: IMD official Nagaratnam states that the severe depression over the southeast and southwest Bay of Bengal is moving north-northwestwards at 6 km/h, positioned at specific latitudes and centering towards the AP coast.

Intensification & Landfall Timing: The system is expected to intensify into a cyclonic storm by today evening and potentially upgrade into a severe cyclonic storm before crossing the coast between Nellore and Tuni around October 19–20.

Wind Speed & High-Risk Districts: Gale-force winds reaching 120–130 km/h (sometimes up to 140–145 km/h) are expected. Krishna, Konaseema, West/East Godavari, Eluru, Kakinada, and parts of Nellore and Ongole are on high alert for torrential rainfall.

Cumulative Impact & Flood Risks: Since consecutive previous cyclones (Arnab and Murasu) already saturated reservoirs and low-lying areas, this third successive severe weather event poses heightened risks of uprooted trees, damaged thatched/mud structures, and waterlogging.

Administrative Coordination & Precautions: The meteorological department is continuously coordinating via phone, email, and WhatsApp with the AP State Disaster Management Authority (APSDMA), Chief Minister’s Office, and district collectors to ensure timely evacuation and emergency response.

Gold Price Trend & International Shifts: Gold has corrected from its peak levels (around $4,000 major support breakdown to $3,900 internationally, reflecting ~₹1,27,000 for 22k in local context) driven by rising US bond yields and shifting monetary policies.

Impact of Inflation & Purchasing Power: While lower gold prices seem attractive, high inflation, rising transportation costs, and increased EMIs squeeze middle-class cash flow, making it harder to purchase physical gold.

The Reality of "Zero Making Charges": In an increasingly organized and intensely competitive retail market, major jewelry brands are slashing making margins (dropping to 6-7% or zero offers) to attract foot traffic despite declining visitor conversions.

Gold vs. Silver Investment Dilemma: Silver ornaments serve primarily as alternative lifestyle accessories or low-liquidity gifts, but they lack the emergency financial security and resale value that gold provides.

Expert Financial Strategy: Senior stock market analyst Sri Ramachandra Murthy advises allocating 20% of monthly income/salary towards gold (either physical or digital/ETFs) as a reliable financial safety net for long-term security.

recentItems.title: ఆక్వాన్ తుఫాన్ ఎఫెక్ట్ 48 గంటలు డేంజర్ : Aquan Cyclone Effect: High Alert! | AP Weather report
recentItems.description:
#CycloneAkvan #APWeather #AndhraPradesh #SevereCyclone #WeatherUpdate #BayOfBengal #IMD #BreakingNews #CycloneAlert #NaturalDisaster
ఆక్వాన్ తుఫాన్ ఎఫెక్ట్ 48 గంటలు డేంజర్ : Aquan Cyclone Effect: High Alert! | AP Weather report 


System Formation & Movement: The deep depression over the southeast and adjoining southwest Bay of Bengal is moving north-northwestwards at a speed of 8 km/h, rapidly intensifying into a cyclonic storm named "Akvan" (proposed by Iran).   Current Positioning: Centered roughly 720 km away from Chennai, 820 km from Visakhapatnam, and 940 km from Gopalpur, scaling up its velocity hourly.   Severity & Wind Speed: Forecasted to upgrade into a Severe Cyclonic Storm, bringing ferocious gale-force winds reaching speeds of 120–130 kmph with gusts up to 145 kmph.
